label: How the owner's Reset Password works

params.name: alphabet
params.label: Characters a generated password uses (no look-alikes)

description_nl: User Access → Reset Password. A generated password is made on the SERVER from these characters (no 0/O, 1/l/I). 'Require change at next login' starts ticked; 'Email the new password' starts unticked.
